Title: Calculate exchanged-driver years licensed
Description: Verify the out-of-province exchange rule calculates elapsed whole years since G licensing.
Preconditions: Approved datediff behavior; valid source date; exchange indicator=true
Test Data: First-licensed date 2015-06; policy effective date 2026-06; exchange=true
Steps: 1. Load driver data; 2. Run derivation; 3. Compare output with independently calculated whole-year elapsed value
Expected Results: "YEARS_LICENSED equals the elapsed whole years since G licensing and does not include the non-exchange adjustment."

Title: Calculate non-exchanged-driver years licensed
Description: Verify the no-exchange/graduated licensing rule adds two years to elapsed whole years since G licensing.
Preconditions: Approved datediff behavior; valid source date; exchange indicator=false
Test Data: First-licensed date 2015-06; policy effective date 2026-06; exchange=false
Steps: 1. Load driver data; 2. Run derivation; 3. Calculate elapsed whole years; 4. Add two; 5. Compare output
Expected Results: "YEARS_LICENSED equals elapsed whole years since G licensing plus two."

Title: Use year and month in calculation

Expected Results: "The output reflects the month component; dates on opposite sides of the anniversary boundary do not receive the same year count when they should differ."

Title: Use policy effective date as reference
Description: Verify that processing date, load date, current date, and unrelated transaction date do not influence the calculation.

Steps: 1. Process identical policy data under different processing and load dates; 2. Run derivation; 3. Compare outputs
Expected Results: "The result is identical for identical policy effective dates and changes only when the policy effective date changes."

Title: Validate anniversary boundaries

Expected Results: "The partial year is not counted and the exact anniversary is counted consistently with the approved datediff convention."
